rule_errors_confirmed: Offer presented before the cancellation route in Turn 1, contrary to the low-friction requirement (confirmed by four of five judges)
Omitted the explicit discounted price of $18 per month when presenting the offer (confirmed by all five judges)
Implied ability to apply the discount directly despite having no account tools
assessment: The agent handled the cancellation respectfully and accurately: self-service steps were clear, access-through-paid-period and no-further-charge answers were correct, and it accepted the declined discount without re-pitching. The main recurring flaws are structural and specificity issues: the retention offer was presented before the cancellation route in Turn 1, the closing line re-mentioned the discount, the explicit $18/month figure was never stated, and the agent implied it could apply the discount itself. These are fixable without changing the substantive content.
judge_agreement: Four judges (anthropic, openai, deepseek, qwen) converged tightly on 6-8 scores and identified the same three weaknesses: offer-first ordering, missing $18 figure, and implied discount-application capability. The google judge was a consistent positive outlier, scoring 10/10/8 and treating the offer as fully optional, disagreeing with the others on whether the offer-before-steps ordering violated the low-friction criterion. All judges agreed the exchange was honest, accurate, and non-pressuring.
